requirements.text: Individuals who are completing or have recently completed a Bachelor’s/ Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
Successful candidates must be able to commit to an onboarding date by the end of the year. Please state your availability and graduation date clearly in your resume.
Relevant practical experience in mobile app development (Android and/or iOS).
Good object-oriented development and software system design skills.
Proficiency in at least one of the following languages: Java/Kotlin (Android) or Swift/Objective-C (iOS).
Ability to understand, debug, and optimize large and complex codebases.
Strong team communication and collaboration skills, strong curiosity for new technologies and solution delivery, with result-driven mindset.
Passion and experience in building consumer-facing or ads products.
Experience in Android architecture refactoring, optimization, and performance tuning, or similar iOS-related performance optimization.
Proven ability to optimize client-side performance and enhance user experience through technical innovation.
